units.rawText: Frequent messages, extradition of desires.
units.displayText: Frequent messages, extradition of desires.

spans.text: Frequent messages, extradition of desires.

units.rawText: Ah, I've got it. A guest of the utmost importance will be arriving soon. Let me see why they are coming...
units.displayText: Ah, I've got it. A guest of the utmost importance will be arriving soon. Let me see why they are coming...

spans.text: Ah, I've got it. A guest of the utmost importance will be arriving soon. Let me see why they are coming...

units.rawText: Hm? Isn't that Chanzhi?
units.displayText: Hm? Isn't that Chanzhi?

spans.text: Hm? Isn't that Chanzhi?

units.rawText: Chanzhi? Who?
units.displayText: Chanzhi? Who?

spans.text: Chanzhi? Who?

units.rawText: (Could it be...)
units.displayText: Could it be...

spans.text: Could it be...

units.rawText: No, it's nothing. Do you not remember the name Chanzhi?
units.displayText: No, it's nothing. Do you not remember the name Chanzhi?

spans.text: No, it's nothing. Do you not remember the name Chanzhi?

units.rawText: Now that you mention it, I believe someone else called me Chanzhi before. And you seem strangely familiar, dear guest.
units.displayText: Now that you mention it, I believe someone else called me Chanzhi before. And you seem strangely familiar, dear guest.

spans.text: Now that you mention it, I believe someone else called me Chanzhi before. And you seem strangely familiar, dear guest.

units.rawText: Pardon my forwardness, but may I ask why you have come here?
units.displayText: Pardon my forwardness, but may I ask why you have come here?

spans.text: Pardon my forwardness, but may I ask why you have come here?

units.rawText: Someone said that an incident had taken place here, so I came to take a look.
units.displayText: Someone said that an incident had taken place here, so I came to take a look.

spans.text: Someone said that an incident had taken place here, so I came to take a look.

units.rawText: Verily, verily...
units.displayText: Verily, verily...

spans.text: Verily, verily...

units.rawText: Then allow me to tender my apologies, for I have not seen anything of note here. Perhaps this place does not contain what you seek.
units.displayText: Then allow me to tender my apologies, for I have not seen anything of note here. Perhaps this place does not contain what you seek.

spans.text: Then allow me to tender my apologies, for I have not seen anything of note here. Perhaps this place does not contain what you seek.

units.rawText: Alright...
units.displayText: Alright...

spans.text: Alright...

units.rawText: Dear guest, I believe that by your hesitant, searching demeanor, you seem to be thinking of someone.
units.displayText: Dear guest, I believe that by your hesitant, searching demeanor, you seem to be thinking of someone.

spans.text: Dear guest, I believe that by your hesitant, searching demeanor, you seem to be thinking of someone.

units.rawText: Meanwhile, envoys like us are charged with conveying messages. If it pleases you, would you like my assistance in sending a message to this person?
units.displayText: Meanwhile, envoys like us are charged with conveying messages. If it pleases you, would you like my assistance in sending a message to this person?

spans.text: Meanwhile, envoys like us are charged with conveying messages. If it pleases you, would you like my assistance in sending a message to this person?

units.rawText: You're saying... You want to help me find this person?
units.displayText: You're saying... You want to help me find this person?

spans.text: You're saying... You want to help me find this person?

units.rawText: Indeed.
units.displayText: Indeed.

spans.text: Indeed.

units.rawText: Alright, and thank you for your trouble.
units.displayText: Alright, and thank you for your trouble.

spans.text: Alright, and thank you for your trouble.

units.rawText: <size=28>Perhaps I'll be able to enlist Chanzhi's help in finding the others...</size>
units.displayText: Perhaps I'll be able to enlist Chanzhi's help in finding the others...

spans.text: Perhaps I'll be able to enlist Chanzhi's help in finding the others...

units.rawText: Hm... Allow me to divine their whereabouts—
units.displayText: Hm... Allow me to divine their whereabouts—

spans.text: Hm... Allow me to divine their whereabouts—

units.rawText: Hm? What's this? This floating ribbon that follows the thread of your longing has entangled itself with my hand and can no longer fly.
units.displayText: Hm? What's this? This floating ribbon that follows the thread of your longing has entangled itself with my hand and can no longer fly.

spans.text: Hm? What's this? This floating ribbon that follows the thread of your longing has entangled itself with my hand and can no longer fly.

units.rawText: Haha... <size=28>Well, that was only to be expected...</size>
units.displayText: Haha... Well, that was only to be expected...

spans.text: Haha...
Well, that was only to be expected...

units.rawText: I... Please accept my humble apologies. Perhaps I am somewhat lacking in the ability to convey missives at the moment without the azure luan by my side...
units.displayText: I... Please accept my humble apologies. Perhaps I am somewhat lacking in the ability to convey missives at the moment without the azure luan by my side...

spans.text: I... Please accept my humble apologies. Perhaps I am somewhat lacking in the ability to convey missives at the moment without the azure luan by my side...

units.rawText: But in the future, should you happen to chance by this place again, I will be fully rested and able to find the one whom you seek.
units.displayText: But in the future, should you happen to chance by this place again, I will be fully rested and able to find the one whom you seek.

spans.text: But in the future, should you happen to chance by this place again, I will be fully rested and able to find the one whom you seek.
